summary: Completed comprehensive responsive layout testing for Hyatt Candolim self-ordering kiosk. Verified hybrid layout implementation with 3-column landscape and 2-column portrait modes.
passed_tests: Login page renders correctly in landscape mode (1920x1080)
Login page renders correctly in portrait mode (1080x1920)
Kiosk page shows 3-column layout in landscape (Categories sidebar | Menu grid | Cart panel)
Kiosk page shows 2-column layout in portrait (Category pills + Menu 58% | Cart 42%)
Categories sidebar visible and functional in landscape mode
Category pills (horizontal scrollable) visible and functional in portrait mode
Cart section visible and accessible in both orientations
Menu items grid adapts correctly (2 cols portrait, 4 cols landscape)
useOrientation() hook correctly detects orientation changes
Category navigation works in both sidebar and pills modes
